headline: Callahan's Passage Erupts in Heavy Casualties as Northern Fronts Shift
war_summary: Severe bloodletting erupted across Callahan's Passage over the past two hours, where combined casualties surged past twenty-two hundred even as fortified lines held unbroken. To the north, Nevish Line and Weathered Expanse remain the fiercest flashpoints on the map, registering nine strategic base transitions between them in the latest two-hour stretch around Princefal, Blackcoat Way, Crow's Nest, and Shattered Advance. Kuura Strand preserved its volatile pace with two fresh base shifts recorded near Faden Point. By contrast, Linn of Mercy paused its structural turnover following intense morning fighting over Lathair, while the Dead Lands saw casualty rates diminish substantially. Stlican Shelf recorded a lone base transfer at Breaker Town amidst steady skirmishing, and Marban Hollow remained quiet through the afternoon following earlier volatility at Checkpoint Bua. In the deep rear sectors across the south, quiet conditions prevail under uncontested Colonial garrisons.
